title: Breaking Routing And Inter-device Dependencies in Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2611.32572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale, Expert Parallelism (EP) becomes increasingly important for distributing experts across devices. However, the resulting token dispatch and combine operations can become a major bottleneck during inference. Overlapping these communication phases with computation is constrained by the sequential dependencies of standard MoE architectures. We introduce BRAID-MoE, an architecture that pairs laddered residual connections with early routing to relax these dependencies. Laddered residuals enable each expert combine to be deferred to the following block, while early routing computes the next routing decision from the pre-combine residual, with experts still receiving the updated post-combine hidden state. This creates an extended communication window in which the preceding combine and next dispatch can execute back-to-back on a dedicated communication stream, overlapping attention computation. translated_title: 打破混合专家模型中的路由与设备间依赖
translated_abstract: 随着混合专家模型规模的不断扩大，专家并行在将专家分布到多个设备上变得越来越重要。然而，由此产生的令牌分发与聚合操作可能成为推理过程中的主要瓶颈。将通信阶段与计算进行重叠会受到标准MoE架构顺序依赖关系的限制。我们提出了BRAID-MoE，这是一种将阶梯式残差连接与早期路由相结合以放宽这些依赖关系的架构。阶梯式残差使每个专家聚合操作可以延迟到下一个模块执行，而早期路由则基于聚合前的残差计算下一次路由决策，同时专家仍接收更新后的聚合后隐状态。这创造了一个延长的通信窗口，使前一个聚合操作和下一个分发操作可以在专用通信流上背靠背执行，并与注意力计算重叠。（原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: 提出BRAID-MoE架构，通过阶梯式残差连接与早期路由打破MoE模型中的顺序依赖，实现通信与注意力计算的深度重叠，缓解专家并行推理中令牌分发与聚合的通信瓶颈。
en_tdlr: BRAID-MoE breaks sequential dependencies in MoE architectures via laddered residual connections and early routing, enabling back-to-back communication overlapped with attention computation to alleviate the token dispatch/combine bottleneck in expert-parallel inference.
